recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore Device.patient for this issue; any future example or wording refinements should be raised against the current DeviceAssociation model as a new editorial decision.
issue_request: FHIR-21236 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking Device.patient to cover devices affixed to or associated to a patient for their specific use, with requirements explaining implanted or otherwise patient-used devices such as wheelchairs and oxygen tanks.
initial_application: The requested wording appeared in the R5-era Device source imported by commit 33b409a4b6, and FHIR-30243 later renamed Device.patient to Device.subject while preserving the FHIR-21236 definition and requirements. FHIR-32570 then moved the subject association into Device.association.humanSubject.
additional_context: Later published/applied Device issues, especially FHIR-38904 and FHIR-39226, moved patient association history out of Device into DeviceAssociation to avoid PHI leakage for reusable devices. The current build has Device and DeviceAssociation as active resources, maps Device.patient to DeviceAssociation in fhir.ini, and defines DeviceAssociation.subject plus a DeviceAssociation-patient search parameter for patient associations.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing Device.patient would target an inactive element, while the current DeviceAssociation conformance source and narrative already cover patient associations for non-affixed devices.
